versions.changelog:
- Added a user-facing greeting step: now, when triggered, prompts users to choose the meeting mode and explains the required materials for each mode (offline, hybrid, online) before proceeding.
- Introduced a detailed, explicit “首次对话提示” section to guide users in selecting meeting type and preparing/uploading the correct files.
- Improved clarity and completeness of usage instructions, especially for material preparation and process expectations.
- No changes to report automation logic or JSON structure; solely improves user onboarding and initial workflow.

medical-training-report v1.0.0

- Initial release providing automated generation of digestive endoscopy training activity reports.
- Supports three training meeting modes (offline/hybrid/online) with a unified report template.
- Extracts key fields and content from various common training materials (posters, PPT photos, Excel for scores/quiz/feedback, schedules, sign-in sheets).
- Includes intelligent summarization of PPT and meeting transcripts, and auto-fills key sections (opening speech, highlights, etc.) if not provided.
- Outputs structured report and summary, with automatic Excel parsing for scores, quizzes, and feedback where available.
